result.description: Advance Vision Technology   About the Role   As our business continues to expand, we are seeking an experienced ICT Business Analyst to join our Melbourne office and work closely with enterprise clients across a range of ICT projects involving business systems, software implementation, digital transformation and systems integration.  This is a senior consulting role responsible for analysing business operations, identifying technology opportunities, gathering and documenting business requirements, and working closely with stakeholders and software development teams to deliver high-quality ICT solutions.  The successful candidate will play a critical role throughout the entire project lifecycle, from requirements analysis and solution design through implementation, testing, deployment and post-implementation support.   Benefits   What We Offer    Competitive remuneration package.   Long-term career opportunities with an established Australian ICT company.   Exposure to enterprise-level digital transformation projects.   Professional development and ongoing technical training.   Collaborative and supportive working environment.   Opportunity to work with clients across multiple industries.   International project exposure where required.     Task & responsibilities   Key Responsibilities   You will be responsible for:   Leading workshops with business stakeholders to gather, analyse and document business requirements.   Analysing existing business processes, workflows and enterprise systems to identify improvement opportunities.   Preparing Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Specification Documents (FSDs), user stories, process maps and workflow documentation.   Performing gap analysis between business requirements and existing system capabilities, recommending practical ICT solutions.   Working closely with software architects, developers, testers and project managers to ensure business requirements are accurately translated into technical solutions.   Preparing process models, workflow diagrams, data flow diagrams and business rules using appropriate modelling tools.   Managing requirements traceability and assessing the impact of change requests throughout project delivery.   Supporting Agile, Scrum and Waterfall software development methodologies.   Coordinating System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), defect management and solution validation.   Supporting enterprise software implementation, systems integration and digital transformation projects.   Facilitating communication between business users and technical teams throughout the SDLC.   Producing user documentation, training materials and conducting client training sessions.   Monitoring project progress, identifying project risks and assisting project managers in delivering successful outcomes.   Providing ongoing post-implementation business analysis and continuous improvement recommendations.   Supporting the company's Australian and international project teams when required.     Qualification & experience   Qualifications   Applicants should possess:   A relevant ICT qualification such as an Advanced Diploma, Diploma, Bachelor's degree or higher in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems or a related discipline. Applicants with substantial industry experience in ICT Business Analysis may also be considered.  Relevant ICT industry certifications will be viewed favorably.    Skills & Experience   The successful applicant should demonstrate:   Minimum 5 years' professional experience as an ICT Business Analyst or Senior Business Analyst.   Strong experience working across the complete Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).   Extensive experience in business requirements elicitation, stakeholder management and business process analysis.   Proven experience preparing BRDs, FSDs, SRS documentation and user stories.   Experience with Agile, Scrum and Waterfall methodologies.   Experience conducting workshops, solution analysis and requirements validation.   Strong understanding of enterprise software implementation and systems integration projects.   Experience coordinating SIT, UAT and production deployment activities.    Experience in one or more of the following will be highly regarded:   Banking or financial services systems   Payment platforms   Enterprise application integration   Digital transformation initiatives   Cloud-based business systems   ERP or CRM implementation projects    About Company     Company Profile   Advance Vision Technology (AVTech) is an Australian ICT solutions provider with more than 30 years of experience delivering innovative enterprise technology solutions across Australia and Asia. Our expertise spans enterprise software, cloud infrastructure, systems integration, cybersecurity, managed ICT services, business applications and digital transformation.      Work Type:  Full time   Salary:  $110000-125000   Job Publish:  21-07-2026   Job Expire:  20-08-2026  Apply on:  ICT BUSINESS ANALYST Job here! result.description:
Position: Telecommunications Technical Officer
Type: Full-time
Employer: Online Star PTY LTD
Location: Canberra ACT
Salary: $80,000 p/a
About the Business
Online Star PTY LTD is a dynamic Canberra-based provider of telecommunications services and solutions, alongside IT services, dedicated to optimising business performance and unlocking new revenue streams in the rapidly evolving communications sector. With a team of highly experienced professionals, we partner with major telecom operators and vendors to deliver customised solutions that help clients enter new markets, defend existing ones, secure networks, improve quality, and deploy infrastructure efficiently. Our core values centre on innovation, operational excellence, cost-effectiveness, and high-quality service delivery, fostering a collaborative and supportive workplace culture where technical expertise drives tangible business outcomes and subscriber satisfaction.
About the Position
The Telecommunications Technical Officer plays a critical role at Online Star PTY LTD in supporting the delivery of NBN fibre and telecommunications network projects. This position involves field-based technical support, testing coordination, quality oversight and technical guidance across active project sites. The role sits between the Project Engineers and the field technicians and is essential to ensuring that network works are delivered to the required technical standards, that faults are diagnosed and rectified efficiently, and that completed works meet client acceptance requirements.
Key Responsibilities
Reviewing job packs, network plans, asset records and scopes of work before field work begins and confirming the design intent against site conditions.
Attending project sites to assess ground conditions, identify service and access risks, and confirm the scoped works can be built to the client design and NBN requirements.
Providing technical direction to field technicians during fibre hauling, splicing, pit and pipe works, exchange patching and BNTD installation.
Coordinating and verifying fibre testing using OTDR and optical power meters, and validating results against applicable NBN and client acceptance requirements before handover to the delivery partner.
Diagnosing fibre, duct, patching and connection faults on site, tracing the cause and setting out the rectification steps required to keep the job on schedule.
Checking completed works against the plans, job packs and NBN specifications, and confirming they are ready for submission to the project manager or delivery partner.
Preparing and updating as-built records, test results, site reports, defect notes and completion packs.
Coordinating with project engineers, supervisors, delivery partners, subcontractors and customers on site access, progress, technical issues and completion sign-off.
Monitoring crews on site to confirm they follow the approved work method, the SWMS and the relevant technical standards.
Escalating complex design, structural or safety matters to the Project Engineers or management where higher-level approval is required.
Reviewing rejected or non-compliant work, identifying why it failed, and instructing field crews on the correct method to bring it back to standard.
Keeping records of materials, equipment, test outcomes, network locations and work status to support project tracking and partner reporting.
Monitoring the performance of completed fibre network segments, interpreting transmission and optical test results, and identifying where network performance requires correction or improvement.
Configuring and integrating telecommunications network equipment, including BNTDs and related network access equipment, and verifying correct operation after installation.
Ensuring compliance with Work Health and Safety obligations on all project sites.
Requirements
Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply.
AQF Associate Degree, Advanced Diploma or Diploma in a relevant field.
Minimum 1 year of relevant experience.
Strong technical skills in telecommunications network testing, fault diagnosis, equipment configuration and integration, including practical experience with OTDR and optical power meters.
Excellent problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, and the capacity to maintain accurate documentation and logs.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills for liaising with internal teams, delivery partners, vendors and clients.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment with a focus on quality standards and operational efficiency.
How to Apply
To apply, applicants must submit their resume with a valid email address through this online portal.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
